Like any living organism, marine mammals are susceptible to viral infections. In 1988 and 2002, thousands of harbor seals died in Europe due to the phocine distemper virus. Many other viruses, including caliciviruses, herpesviruses, adenoviruses, and orthopoxviruses, circulate within marine mammal populations.

The official opening ceremonies were held on 15 February, although two smaller ceremonies were held on 14 February to conform with competition schedules. From 15 February until 25 February, the day of the closing ceremonies, at least one event final was held each day.
